caption:
Global Metadata: A spirited Russian folk dance, 120 BPM, bright and driving. Led by the balalaika (triangular plucked lute) with its bright, crisp, rhythmic plucks, joined by a bayan (Russian button accordion) and a light percussion groove. A group of male voices sings a lively Russian chorus with a strong rhythmic drive. It opens with the balalaika and bayan setting a danceable rhythm, the voices join with a joyful repeated chorus, the balalaika plays a fast driving solo, then the full ensemble returns for a rousing ending. Production profile: warm, close, festive folk recording, bright crisp balalaika, rich accordion, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: A lead male voice sings a lively Russian folk line, joined by a male group chorus. Natural, warm, expressive, no auto-tune. The singing is rhythmic and celebratory. No spoken dialogue.

Arrangement: Intro, the balalaika and bayan set a danceable rhythm. Section one, the male voices join with a joyful repeated chorus. Section two, the balalaika plays a fast driving solo over the accordion and percussion. Section three, the full ensemble returns for a rousing refrain. Outro, a crisp festive ending.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Balalaika and bayan set a danceable rhythm

[Section 1]
Hey! Kalinka, kalinka
ya, kalinka moya!
v lesu yagoda, yagoda
ya malinka moya!

[Section 2]
Balalaika fast driving solo over the accordion and percussion

[Section 3]
Kalinka, kalinka moya!
full ensemble, rousing refrain

[Outro]
A crisp festive ending
